{{Quote|I'm an archaeologist. The traditional robes are poorly suited for crawling through caves. Do not be concerned, my beliefs are strong and true.|Rachi Sitra|<ref name="card" />}}
'''Rachi Sitra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]], and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sitra had once been a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] before going into [[Order 66/Legends|exile]] following its [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|downfall]].

==Biography==
[[File:Clash.jpg|left|thumb|Rachi Sitra in a lightsaber duel with Namman Cha]]

===Early life===
{{Quote|I am now a Jedi Knight.|Rachi Sitra|<ref name="TNR LS">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref>}}
Sitra was rescued from [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] posing as a slave trader, and afterward became a skilled warrior and an [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeologist]].<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://rpgvault.ign.com/articles/897/897312p1.html|text=Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game Peek #1|work=[[Wikipedia:IGN|IGN]]|archivedate=20081010171151|author=[[Chuck Kallenbach|Kallenbach, Chuck]]|date=2008-08-08}}</ref> She began learning the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and eventually attained the rank of a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] after completing her trials. The construction of her own [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] was a turning point for Rachi that gave her life new meaning and direction.<ref name="Card-SWGTCG-Becoming a Jedi Knight">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Becoming a Jedi Knight}}</ref> Sitra somehow survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], living long enough to witness the rise of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebellion]] and the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], Sitra finally emerged from exile.

===Battle of Talus and confronting Darth Vader===
{{Quote|We can't defend this facility. Many Padawans are in danger.|Rachi Sitra|<ref name="LS" />}}
[[File:Rachi_Sitra.jpg|thumb|right|Rachi Sitra]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Sitra aided the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] from a hidden [[Talus base|Rebel base]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], helping in organizing strikes against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. However, the base's safety was compromised when the [[Imperial Special Forces/Legends|Imperial Special Forces]] established a base on nearby [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], and prepared to launch an attack on the Rebel base. Sitra realized that the facility could not be properly defended, and evacuating its personnel was the only reliable option.<ref name="LS" /> However, the [[Battle of Talus]] forced Rebels into a defense of the base anyway when the Imperial attack came earlier than expected. Imperial troops disembarked and immediately engaged the Rebel defenders, but were caught by surprise when a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], led by Rachi Sitra, joined the fight. Sitra took command of the situation and wielded her lightsaber with authority. The combined troops of the Rebel Alliance successfully defended their base on Talus, and the Imperials retreated to the Imperial outpost.<ref>{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref>

The next day saw the second Imperial assault, with a larger, more organized attack force, although by that time the evacuation was already at its final stage. Sitra was evacuated, along with other base personnel, on ''[[Spirit of Corellia]]'', a [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] transport. However, the transport was shot down, and forced to crash-land at a remote part of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Very soon, Imperial forces arrived to investigate the crash site, led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Sitra decided to distract Vader and buy the others time to escape. She rushed the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]], her lightsaber ignited, but the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] simply struck her down with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], rendering her unconscious. Vader's forces engaged the Rebels, and the fight was fierce and brutal, with heavy casualties for both sides. Finally regaining consciousness, Sitra moved against Vader again. At that moment, the surviving Rebels concentrated their blaster fire on Vader and, while he was busy deflecting it, Sitra and her troopers retreated from the battle into the wilderness. Within a few hours, they reached a local spaceport and reunited with the main Alliance forces.<ref name="LS" />

===Capture===
{{Quote|Get behind me. I'll take care of these bounty hunters.|Rachi Sitra|<ref name="Galactic Hunters">{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref>}}
[[File:Rachi_Sitra_-_GH.jpg|thumb|left|Sitra in her traditional Jedi historian robe]]
Following the [[Battle of Talus]], Sitra was put onto the [[Emperor's Most Wanted]], a list which contained high-pay bounties on critical Alliance leaders. Sitra was selected as a target by none other than [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] himself, who has been tracking her movements for weeks before commencing an attack. Sitra was on her way to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] for a [[Diplomatic mission to Dathomir|diplomatic mission]], and upon entering [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] space, her shuttle was ambushed by [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] from behind an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]. With a precise shot from a heavy blaster cannon, Fett neutralized the shuttle's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and commenced boarding actions. When the [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] was forced open, Sitra ignited her lightsaber and prepared to defend herself, but Fett fired a rocket from his [[Wrist rocket/Legends|wrist launcher]], which knocked the lightsaber out of her hands. Bruised and battered, the Jedi had no choice but to surrender herself to the bounty hunter. Fett locked [[Energy binder/Legends|energy binders]] on her hands and prepared to deliver her to the Imperial authorities.<ref name="Galactic Hunters" />

The temporary holding place for the captured Rebels was an Imperial prison facility located in a rough mountainous area just outside [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Sitra was handed over to the Imperial authorities, but Rebel agents learned the location of the facility and launched a bold raid in an attempt to rescue the prisoners. Despite heavy resistance from Imperial forces, the Rebels gained the upper hand and spirited the rescued prisoners, including Sitra, to safety.<ref>{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref>

===Confrontation with Jeffren Brek===
[[File:Explosive_Ending.jpg|thumb|right|Sitra evades the grenade explosion.]]
At some point, Rachi had discovered the Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Jeffren Brek]] during her mission. She tried to subdue him, but Brek launched a [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] at her, buying himself time to escape and ending the confrontation.<ref name="Card-SWGTCG-Explosive Ending">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Explosive Ending}}</ref> Brek continued his mission, and when Sitra found him again, she made him pay dearly by [[Cho mok/Legends|cutting off]] his left arm with her lightsaber.<ref name="Card-SWGTCG-Costly Defeat">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Costly Defeat}}</ref>

===Search for the Nightsister on Hoth===
{{Quote|I don't want to fight you. I'm looking for an exiled Nightsister.|Rachi Sitra|<ref name="TNR LS" />}}
While on a mission on Dathomir, Sitra was told by [[Augwynne Djo]], the leader of the [[Singing Mountain Clan]] of [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witches]], of a dangerous [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Kyrisa]], who had mastered the power of [[Animal bond|Animal friendship]]. So dangerous was she that her own clan had sent her away from the planet. Knowing that the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Namman Cha]] was intending to recruit Kyrisa to serve the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], Sitra decided to find her first. She learned that the Nightsister had crashed on a remote [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet known as [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], and Sitra established contact with an [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] unit that had just begun establishing a small outpost on the planet. Recruiting a Rebel agent to help her in her search, they traveled to Hoth, where the two decided to keep a strict search protocol and stay in touch with each other.<ref name="TNR LS" /> Several hours into her search, Sitra, after dispatching a local [[Hoth hog/Legends|Hoth hog]], was confronted by one of the Imperial agents looking for Kyrisa. Rachi eventually was reluctant to fight him, but after the Imperial announced his intent to bring the Nightsister to the Emperor, she decided to neutralize him.<ref name="DS">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref>

[[File:Wampa_Fight.jpg|thumb|left|Sitra was attacked by a wampa during her search.]]
However, her opponent proved agile in the fight, and once there was a lull in the combat, Rachi offered him to simply part and go separate ways. Having found an agreement, she escaped into the snow.<ref name="DS" /> She was soon contacted by her companion, who discovered that Namman Cha was also involved in the search. As her companion was no match for a trained [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Rachi sent him to help the Rebels at the outpost and continued her search alone.<ref name="TNR LS" /> Her combat skills helped her when she came under attack by one of Hoth's native [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]].<ref name="Card-SWGTCG-Wampa Fight">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Wampa Fight}}</ref> Her quest ultimately failed, as Cha had found the Nightsister and persuaded her to join him.<ref name="Card-SWGTCG-Final Clash">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Final Clash|nobackup=1}}</ref> However, her presence still proved useful when the Imperials [[Battle of Hoth (2 ABY)|attacked]] the small Alliance outpost. Sitra helped the Rebels defend it and crippled an [[All Terrain Personal Transport/Legends|AT-PT]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] during the battle.<ref name="Card-SWGTCG-Hamstring">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Hamstring}}</ref>

===Dathomir===
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Rachi Sitra was on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during the [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|blackwing virus outbreak]]. While there, Sitra together with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] had to fight a horde of Imperial [[Zombie/Legends|undeads]].<ref name="SWG:DT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=item|Death Troopers}}</ref>

==Powers and abilities==
[[File:Sun_Djem_GH_by_Michael_Komarck.png|thumb|200x200px|right|Rachi using the Form I maneuver [[Sun djem/Legends|sun djem]]]]
Rachi Sitra was highly skilled in lightsaber combat. She favored the [[Form VI/Legends|Niman]] form, but she was also trained in the use of [[Form I/Legends|Form I]] and [[Form V/Legends|Shien]]. In addition to her skill with a single blade, Sitra was skilled in [[Jar'Kai/Legends|Jar'Kai]]. Her dueling abilities were so great that she was even capable of the advanced [[Kai-kan]] technique. She had considerable [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetic]] prowess, being able to manipulate her lightsaber in order to form a saber barrier.
